_doc: Fallback navigation, used only if no WordPress menu is assigned to a location yet (Appearance -> Menus always wins - see NavigationService::menu()). Structure (including optional 'children' for a dropdown) extracted from traditional_template/admin/data/nav.json - header.php/footer.php read 'url' directly and don't iterate 'children' yet, so it's inert extra data for now rather than a functional dropdown, per 'preserve useful structure/relationships' without changing the PHP that already consumes this file. 'url' values match config/routes.php's raw paths for the 'home'/'about'/'game'/'contact' example routes - keep them in sync if a route's path changes, since this fallback file (unlike component code) is not read through RouteService.

header_cta._doc: The persistent header action button (reference design: 'BOOK US / FOR YOUR EVENT' with a calendar icon, present on every page, not just Home - distinct from data/content/cta.json's Home-only closing CTA band). 'route' is a config/routes.php key, resolved through RouteService::url(), same rule as everywhere else - never a raw path here.
header_cta.label: Book Us
